chapterTitle: The Strategy of the Void: Deny Them Targets
coreMove: Deny efficient attack by removing fixed centers, public faces, and single points of collapse while keeping the system coherent enough to keep operating.
reversal: Diffusion becomes self-defeating when it eliminates responsibility and action clarity along with vulnerability.
teachingEmphasis: treat the void as denied target rather than mystique
separate coherent decentralization from evasive disorder
show how resilience comes from removing single points of failure
avoid romanticizing opacity or accountability avoidance
